alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest option integrates information processing, AI, human-centred design and language. Law and IT and business information science are independently evidenced elective directions with substantial legal or organisational sequences. The three options meet the distinctness floor. AI and language are represented in the closest option, and the other named directions remain beyond the three-option limit.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both teach relational database design and SQL. Groningen also develops database-driven web applications.
Both teach data cleaning and manipulation. UCR also introduces data visualisation.
Both teach machine-learning methods and model evaluation.
Both study neural networks and text applications. Groningen gives dedicated attention to language models and translation.
Both introduce programming and computational problem solving.
The selected UCR courses cover parts of information science. Groningen introduces it as a discipline.
UCR covers software and databases. Groningen teaches web development as a separate subject.
UCR algorithms and optimisation teach general search methods. Groningen studies search engines and information retrieval.
UCR logic, mathematics and data science supply foundations. Groningen separately studies information measures and encoding.
UCR studies AI models and optimisation. Groningen separately develops and evaluates work produced through human collaboration with generative AI.
UCR data courses include applied projects. Groningen requires a separate data science project.
Both investigate user needs and develop prototypes. UCR works with consumer products, while Groningen tests computer interfaces.
Both analyse linguistic choices and textual data. UCR focuses on stylistics, while Groningen connects linguistic theory to language technology.
UCR studies social aspects of technology across several subjects. Groningen gives humane AI dedicated interdisciplinary study.
The UCR courses include projects in design, ethics and AI. Groningen integrates these concerns in a dedicated humane AI project.
UCR Psycholinguistics investigates human speech and language. Groningen teaches computational processing of speech and language.
UCR Robotics studies movement, planning and manipulation. Groningen teaches spoken interfaces and evaluation of human-robot interaction.
Both introduce statistical analysis and inference. UCR applies these methods to business and social research.
Both examine ethical questions about technology. UCR focuses on AI, while Groningen covers information technology more broadly.
This is approved elective space.
The Groningen thesis is required. UCR independent research is optional and appears separately.

notes.text: UCR offers related study in software, data, AI, language and technology use. Groningen gives more dedicated attention to web development, search engines, speech technology and human-robot interaction, and requires a data science project and thesis.

audience.programmeDescription: Information Science at the University of Groningen combines applied AI, data science and language technology. Students study how to build information systems and evaluate how they serve people and society.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR option combines AI and data with language, design and behaviour. Two related options focus on law and technology governance, or on business information systems.

componentNotes.y3-minor: Students can use this 30 EC space for a minor or combine a 15 EC Information Science placement with 15 EC of minor courses.
componentNotes.y3-thesis: The thesis requires at least 120 EC, including all first-year courses.
